# Permit Engineering (Eng Tech Net, Inc.)

> Signed and sealed permit drawings for fire alarm, access control, low voltage/CCTV, electrical, and structural sign contractors across Florida. Designed by Marlon Sebelen, a Florida Professional Engineer (Electrical, PE No. 67659) who is also a licensed Florida Electrical Contractor (EC13004430) and NICET Level III certified, with 25 years in the fire alarm and access control industry.

## Services
- Fire alarm permit drawings: risers, device layouts, NAC circuits, sequence of operations, battery calculations (NFPA 72, FBC, FFPC)
- Access control permit drawings: door schedules and hardware
- Low voltage, CCTV and intrusion permit drawings
- Electrical permit drawings: power plans, panel schedules, load calculations, service changes (NFPA 70/NEC)
- Structural sign permit drawings: channel letters, storefront signs, attachment and wind load

## Pages
- [Fire Alarm Permit Drawings](https://www.permitengineering.com/fire-alarm-permit-drawings/): Signed and sealed fire alarm permit drawings for Florida contractors: risers, device layouts, NAC circuits, sequence of operations and battery calcs to NFPA 72, FBC and FFPC.
- [Access Control Permit Drawings](https://www.permitengineering.com/access-control-permit-drawings/): Door-by-door access control permit drawings for Florida contractors: hardware schedules, fire alarm release, egress compliance and head-end layout, signed and sealed by a PE.
- [Low Voltage & CCTV Permit Drawings](https://www.permitengineering.com/low-voltage-cctv-permit-drawings/): Signed and sealed low voltage permit drawings for Florida contractors: CCTV and video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercom and structured cabling, per NFPA 70 and FBC.
- [Electrical Permit Drawings](https://www.permitengineering.com/electrical-permit-drawings/): Sealed electrical permit drawings for Florida commercial projects of any size: power plans, panel schedules, load calculations, service changes and equipment connections per NFPA 70 (NEC).
- [Sign Permit Drawings](https://www.permitengineering.com/sign-permit-drawings/): Engineered sign permit drawings for Florida sign contractors: channel letters, raceways, storefront and wall signs, with wind load calcs, attachment details and sign electrical.
- [Broward County](https://www.permitengineering.com/broward-county/): Signed and sealed fire alarm, access control, low voltage, electrical and sign permit drawings for contractors in Broward County, from a PE based in Davie.
- [Miami-Dade County](https://www.permitengineering.com/miami-dade-county/): Signed and sealed fire alarm, access control, low voltage, electrical and sign permit drawings for contractors in Miami-Dade County, drawn for your city's AHJ.
- [Palm Beach County](https://www.permitengineering.com/palm-beach-county/): Signed and sealed fire alarm, access control, low voltage, electrical and sign permit drawings for contractors in Palm Beach County, drawn for your local AHJ.
